title: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is dead code that will confuse callers
description: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs { curve: EcCurve } is exported in the public API but can never be produced by the current decrypt() path. EC key agreement goes through the KARI path which calls agree_ecdh() — not decrypt_cek(). Callers implementing DecryptionKey see the variant, try to match on it in decrypt_cek(), and wonder why it never fires. The variant should either be removed or the decrypt_cek() call path should be updated to route ECDH through it consistently.
